title: Renaming rules follow-ups after budget-mkrt: exact other-payee name wins on edit, client auto-association vs second same-day ride, scope provider check, fresh-start re-import duplicates carried rows
description: From review-mkrt-5.md and review-mkrt-4.md (on budget-mkrt). F-A edited-payee.ts:66: an exact name of ANOTHER live payee should win before the case-insensitive 'unchanged' check (two payees differing only by case). F-B the 'second same-price ride is imported' improvement applies only to plain-text rows; the released client auto-associates texts containing a payee's name, so such rides arrive as chosen rows and the second is still dropped as on main. F-C the provider-prefix check in store/transfers.ts:64 reads every user's connections; scope to the row's account connection. F-D re-importing a statement into a fresh-start copy duplicates carried rows (pre-existing on main). Also: on create and repeat rules let an exact live payee name win before the rules; tell the old client's user when a payee has more rules than it shows.
